notes.title: Pause Bug Solved - Online Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hi there,
Few of our tester reported, there was a bug in Online Multiplayer. We then find the problem and just fix it as soon as possible.
We are open to all ideas to improve and make this game more interesting. Also, we think, it would be great If we can polish and fix bugs as much as possible!
If players want to share an opinion or give a suggestion and feedback, can use the Community Hub or find us using Discord at https://discord.gg/zvz4s2mbmx

Enjoy!
